label: Bible Study
prompt: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are _____, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
verse: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
note: Raised with Christ? Then look up — that's where he's seated.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy _____ be.
verse: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.
note: Moses's blessing on Asher: as thy days, so shall thy strength be — strength measured out to match each day.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Now this was the manner in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning changing, for to confirm all things; a man plucked off his _____, and gave it to his neighbour: and this was a testimony in Israel.
verse: Now this was the manner in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning changing, for to confirm all things; a man plucked off his shoe, and gave it to his neighbour: and this was a testimony in Israel.
note: In old Israel a deal was sealed by handing over a shoe — the nearer kinsman's shoe gave Boaz the right to marry Ruth.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, _____ thou bless me.
verse: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
note: Jacob wrestled all night and, hip out of joint, still wouldn't let go without a blessing.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Keeping mercy for thousands, _____ iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.
verse: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.
note: Part of God's self-portrait on Sinai: keeping mercy for thousands, 'forgiving' iniquity and transgression and sin.
